Sample 2 · Rav Tzadok

Tzidkas HaTzadik

Siman 1 · Beginning Avodas Hashem

רֵאשִׁית כְּנִיסַת הָאָדָם לַעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם צָרִיךְ לִהְיוֹת בְּחִפָּזוֹן,
The initial entry of a person into the service of God must be done in haste,
צָרִיךְ לִשְׁמֹר הָרֶגַע שֶׁמִּתְעוֹרֵר בּוֹ רְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם,
one must seize the precise moment in which an awakening to the will of God occurs,

Two selected phrases from Siman 1; the published passage includes the intervening text.

Sample 3 · The Ishbitz tradition

Mei HaShiloach

Chelek Beis · Bereishis

עֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת בְּמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית וַעֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת בְּמַתַּן תּוֹרָה,
Ten utterances brought forth the work of Creation, and ten utterances were uttered at the Giving of the Torah,
הַיְינוּ כְּשֶׁהָאָדָם יִרְצֶה לְהַכִּיר אֶת אַחְדוּת ה'
meaning that when a person wishes to recognize the unity of Hashem,

Consecutive phrases from the interlinear Chelek Beis edition. Also available for Parashas Noach.
